original.target_description: Object Contact: main effect of INTERACTIONgrasp,ward on movement execution time, pooled over food and ball objects.

es.quote:
Ward movements were executed faster than grasp movements (Mean difference:

218.72 ms, SE=60.88 ms) as reflected by a significant main effect of

INTERACTIONgrasp,ward, F(1,19)=12.90, p=.002, ηp²=0.41.
